$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F02 GCD detail (A6): the right wing up close from the front right, framed on the wing. The GCD replaces the two pin heads as on IMG_3423: centered between them, scaled by their spacing (2.64 mm) and height (1.68 mm); the wing's face is seen at about 40 degrees, so the emblem is foreshortened the same way.
